Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Rust SDK

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB Rust Software Development Kit (SDK) is now in public preview. You can use the Rust SDK to connect to an Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL account and perform operations on databases, containers, and items. In addition to creating, reading, updating and deleting items, you can also execute queries that are scoped to a single partition. To help provide secure access to your data, you can authenticate your requests using role-based access control through Microsoft Entra ID instead of using the primary key for your account.  

 

Learn more.
